Problem Statement:
You are given the length A and breadth B of a rectangle. Calculate and print the area C of the rectangle. 
Input Description:
Two natural numbers A and B representing the length and breadth of a rectangle. 
Output Description:
Print the area of the rectangle. If required, round off the result to the first decimal place. 
Sample Input:
2
3 
Sample Output:
6
